units.hansik_sales_krw: KRW per quarter (source column says 당월 but it is the quarter total)
units.shares: fractions of their own column group; age/sex exclude corporate cards
units.flpop_total: as served (sum of the 7 weekday columns); compare within dataset only

meta.caveat: 추정매출 has no category finer than 한식 (CS100001); pork-level demand is an allocation.

survival.cohort: licenses approved on/after 2015-01-01, right-censored at run date. 한식 = 업태 ['한식']; recent licenses often use 업태 '기타' (cafes, 마라탕, some 한식), so the 한식 cohort undercounts. all_uptae is the broad restaurant baseline.

pork_like_primary_plus_fringe.definition: Licenses of any 업태 whose name contains a pork/grill keyword (config license.name_keywords) or that matched an sbiz I20107 store (high/medium). Heuristic; keywords also catch 소고기 places. Current I20107 matches are survivors, so this group leans optimistic.

survival_wide.cohort: licenses approved on/after 2015-01-01, right-censored at run date
survival_wide.pork_like_definition: license name contains a pork/grill keyword (config license.name_keywords) or the license matched an sbiz I20107 store (high/medium). Name keywords also catch some 소고기 places; I20107 matches are current survivors.
survival_wide.pork_name_only_note: PRIMARY comparison: name keyword only. Unbiased by survival, noisier by name.
survival_wide.pork_like_note: name keyword OR matched to a current I20107 store: survivor-biased upward, because only open stores can be matched.
